idea-plugin.name: Project Switcher
idea-plugin.description:
Switch between open and recent projects from a compact keyboard-driven popup.

Press Alt+F2 to open Project Switcher, and again to close it. Type to filter projects by name or location. Search tolerates common typos and supports keyboard-layout correction. Open projects are listed from the most recently used, and the previous project is selected, so Alt+F2 then Enter switches back to it.

Shortcuts
  • Up / Down — move the selection
  • Page Up / Page Down, Home / End — jump through a long list
  • Enter or a click — open the selected project following the IDE's Open project in setting
  • Shift+Enter or Shift+click — open a recent project in the current window
  • Ctrl+Enter or Ctrl+click — open a recent project in a new window
  • Cmd+W on macOS, Ctrl+W elsewhere — close an open project or remove a recent one
  • Esc — clear the search, then close the popup
The window modifiers apply only to recent projects; selecting an already open project focuses its window. The footer of the popup shows the location of the selected project and the keys that act on it.

The shortcut can be changed under Settings | Keymap | Switch Project, and the action is also available from Tools | Switch Project.
